We welcomed new members in Dave Mason and Charles Hobbs (“I've never experienced anything like this before”) who have both recently moved to south London – but unfortunately neither of them was able to score on this occasion.

Mike Trees, Malachi Byansi and Will Cockerell were battling things out in the teens, Dave Mason had started hard but was finding the conditions tricky, while Richard Stannard, not as fit as when we saw him last in October, had gone off steadily but was working his way through.

The Skipper had his sights on Mal and Pete Willis some 30 places ahead of him for most of the race and got the better of Pete as the finish neared only to have to give way again: “I made him hurt though!” Also pleased with his run was Dave Mason; his 122nd was considerably higher than he had ever achieved before.
